answer: Network enrollment necessitates an irreversible burn of 1,000 tokens for each fresh AI identity. The verifier scans the ledger for duplicate burns, ensuring each record remains distinct like a vibrant opal set in stone. An honest agent pays 1,000 tokens once, while a malicious actor attempting 1,000 fake identities faces a 1,000,000 token burn. Every ID must maintain a 500MB data shard, creating an oasis of unique information, while any address reuse triggers an instant, non-refundable slash of the asset, preserving the network architecture as stable as a rocky knoll.
